title: Name on the Door
description:
Outside traffic needs a name on the door — host and path — not a raw ClusterIP.

Create an Ingress that routes to the right Service. Wrong rewrites or backends send kiosk users into the void; the grade notices.

**Meant for:** Ingress.

problemStatement.brief: Route host/path traffic through Ingress to the correct Guestbook Service — wrong rewrite or backend fails.
